[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] '''Alor Keto''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the ruler of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Raised in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], Alor Keto was the ruler of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and ruled for many [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]. A weak and ineffectual leader, Keto was a puppet of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Keto's health was in decline.<ref name="NoP" />
